violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed eating while preparing food and outside of designated area.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. The wood base under the microwaves is not finished.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. The handwashing sink had ice cream in it.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc… were not maintained in good repair. The vinyl flooring in the kitchen is missing under the cooking equipment.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. An open energy drink container was on a shelf with single use items.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood in the kitchen is due for deep cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc… were not maintained in good repair. The vinyl flooring in the kitchen is missing some spots.

General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. The back door to the outside is missing weatherstrip on the sides.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Observed employee pouring dirty water in the handwashing sink.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. The vinyl flooring in the kitchen is missing in some spots.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean clothes, hair restraints, fingernail maint., jewelry, eating/drinking (1 pt deducted)
